timeline.summary: Rootha is called into the Dean of Perfection's office and distracted by a song stuck in her head.
timeline.quote: I've got a song stuck in my head.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Uvilda reprimands Rootha for being the only student to have not applied for a critique, having finished nothing.
timeline.quote: You are the only student who hasn't yet applied for a critique

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Uvilda brings up Rootha's mother, which angers Rootha.
timeline.quote: Your mother was an incredibly talented and delicate caster.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Uvilda gives Rootha a day to bring a finished project or lose her place.
timeline.quote: Or I'm afraid I can no longer guarantee a place for you at Prismari college.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Nassari emerges from a candle flame and teases Rootha outside the office.
timeline.quote: Do you make it a habit to lurk in candle flames during student critiques?

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari offers Rootha less naggingly tiresome advice and tells her there is wild magic in her, triggering a memory.
timeline.quote: There's wild magic in you.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha realizes the song stuck in her head is one her mother used to sing as she painted (flashback).
timeline.quote: My mother used to sing it to herself as she worked.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In her studio, Rootha examines her frozen-water sculpture and decides it is her best bet for the critique.
timeline.quote: I filled a bucket with water and poured it onto the studio floor, freezing it as it splashed back up at me.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Felisa Fang arrives at Rootha's studio door.
timeline.quote: I know you're in there, Rooth. I can sense the melancholia.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Felisa uses flattering Vainglory magic on Rootha.
timeline.quote: Not as pretty as you, though.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha accuses Felisa of using magic on her and sends her away.
timeline.quote: Don't use magic on me.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha smashes her sculpture in anger.
timeline.quote: My sculpture chimes out like a thousand tiny bells as I smash it to pieces on the studio floor.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Drunk and angry, Rootha goes to her mother's endless waterfall on Opus Walk and considers destroying it.
timeline.quote: Her greatest creation: an endless waterfall pouring out of nothing and disappearing back into nowhere.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari stops Rootha with a cord of flame and heals her scalded wrist.
timeline.quote: A slender cord of flame entwines my wrist, more vapor than fire.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari suggests Uvilda is courting the Squallhearts' donations, and Rootha realizes her acceptance may have rested on her mother's fame.
timeline.quote: Maybe it's less your success she's courting, and more the notice of an interested party.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari confides they never liked Rootha's mother.
timeline.quote: I never liked your mother.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari tells Rootha her ordered magic does not suit her, since she feels like the potential before an earthquake.
timeline.quote: That's what you feel like to me.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha tells Nassari how she hurt her little brother as a child and was shunned (flashback).
timeline.quote: I wanted to hurt him, and I did.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha admits she could have killed her brother and enjoyed it.
timeline.quote: I could have killed my brother, and I enjoyed it!

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Goaded by Nassari, Rootha blasts a raw burst of wild magic at them.
timeline.quote: Power bursts hard and blazing from my diaphragm, a hot gout of magic that comes out in a shout.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari catches the blast between their palms and siphons it into Furygale.
timeline.quote: They spring backward into the air and catch my magic between their palms.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari tells Rootha she will not be thrown out of Prismari.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to throw you out of Prismari, Rootha Squallheart.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rootha touches the hanging magic and hears her mother's song within it.
timeline.quote: My mother's song rings in my ears when I touch the magic.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari takes over as Rootha's advisor and declares she passes.
timeline.quote: Uvilda isn't your advisor anymore. I am. And I say you pass.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Nassari tells Rootha she is one of theirs and that they will not let her magic burn away.
timeline.quote: The magic inside you is what I am made of, body and soul.

citation.text: "A Cry of Magic" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Nassari shatters Rootha's ice wall and attacks her, making her petal go dark and the invocation fail.
timeline.quote: The invocation was failing

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint grabs Rootha's petal and pours his life into the invocation to complete it.
timeline.quote: he powered the invocation with his life alone

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: At sunrise, Rootha, shaken by a night terror, sees Dean Nassari on the ridge and tries to flee.
timeline.quote: Dean Nassari stands precariously on a slender jut of rock.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha slips from the ridge as the edge gives way, and a thread of magic yanks her to safety.
timeline.quote: A single thread of magic loops around my wrists and yanks me up.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha meets Glass, who saved her, as he channels magic into a whale for his capstone project.
timeline.quote: "Glassyk. Call me Glass."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha returns to camp and tells Kahri about her fall; Kahri says everyone knows Glass is a savant.
timeline.quote: "Everyone knows him! He's a savant!

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha reveals the Living Flame, which she has finished and shown to no one, and is pulled into a memory of the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: I call it the Living Flame, and it's the greatest thing I've ever made.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: At the gallery, Rootha meets Lux and Justice, who learn she is a Champion who helped drive off the Phyrexians; she flees.
timeline.quote: She was one of the five students who performed the invocation to drive the Phyrexians from campus.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha bumps into Kahri and Dean Nassari appears, but does not look at Rootha.
timeline.quote: Nassari stands right there and doesn't look at me once.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The rogue elemental whale appears and floods the gallery with water.
timeline.quote: An enormous cerulean whale, turned black in the dying evening light, swollen with magic and careening out of control across the summit.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha recognizes Glass inside the whale; Nassari concludes he has lost control.
timeline.quote: "He's lost control of it."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Nassari's flames cut off the whale's limbs, but they grow back, and the boiling water endangers the crowd.
timeline.quote: a jet of flame escapes Nassari's palm

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Flashback to the Biblioplex invocation, where the Phyrexian Nassari taunts Rootha and she loses concentration.
timeline.quote: "You're a burden. You cling.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Quint shores up the casting, saving the others, and later becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: The only reason any of us survive is because of Quint, a quiet boy from Lorehold.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha summons the Living Flame to lend Nassari more force, and takes Nassari's offered hand.
timeline.quote: I take Dean Nassari's hand, and the world around us turns to fire.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Their combined flames destroy the elemental whale in the Night of Flame, and nobody is seriously hurt.
timeline.quote: Shockingly, beyond a few burns and scrapes, no one was hurt that night.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Nassari apologizes for neglecting Rootha and what they said in the Biblioplex, and offers to be her advisor.
timeline.quote: You aren't looking for an advisor still, are you?

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha helps Nassari to their feet, accepting the reconciliation.
timeline.quote: This time, I reach out a hand and pull them to theirs.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha fixates on her perceived failures in the Invocation of the Founders and delays her graduation.
timeline.quote: Rootha has delayed her graduation, unable to finish the thesis she has lingered on for years.

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, so Quint compensates with raw magic and lifeforce; his spark ignites and he planeswalks away, though the Invocation repels the main wave.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion, Quint tries to cover for Rootha at the Invocation of the Founders with raw magic, his spark ignites, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nassari helps Rootha, on the verge of flunking, get back on track.
timeline.quote: Seeing her talent, Nassari helped the student back on track.

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, Quint covers her part with raw magic, his spark ignites and he planeswalks away; Rootha is wounded.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rootha blames herself for Quint's presumed death and avoids Nassari.
timeline.quote: she blamed herself for Quint's presumed death

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Night of Flame". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Summitfest, Rootha protects attendees with the Living Flame in the Night of Flame.
timeline.quote: she protected the festival's attendees using the Living Flame

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Night of Flame". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Killian Lu, Dina, Rootha Squallheart and other returning characters are now recent graduates practicing magic in the wider world.
timeline.quote: are now recent graduates of Strixhaven University, putting their magic to practice in the wider world

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Uvilda isn't your advisor anymore. I am.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Nassari was Rootha's advisor and offers to be so again.
relations.quote: I know, technically, I haven't been yours in years

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

relations.note: Kahri is Rootha's friend who pulls her out of her room.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

relations.note: Glass saves Rootha from the fall.
relations.quote: "I'm glad that Glassyk was there to catch you!"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

relations.note: Quint covered for Rootha's failure in the invocation, and they were two of the five Champions.
relations.quote: He compensates for my failure, shoring up the casting.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

relations.quote: With her mother, Samara Squallheart , being a famous, talented caster

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Under the guidance of Dean Nassari
